_lisez_moi: Text of the /confidentialite page (set by the Worker, src/routes/pages.js). Same keys as src/contenu/fr/confidentialite.json.
brouillon_faire_relire_par_professionnel: Draft, to be reviewed by a professional before the public launch.
responsable_projet_etudiant: The Passation project team (Eros Fragliola, Maxime Parrinello, Victoire Jacob, Ethan Barris and Mohamed Reda Aboualam), a student project of EDHEC Business School, not a registered company. Contact for personal data questions: through the GitHub repository; the “Delete my file” button in your space deletes your file and its documents at any time.
votre_adresse_e_mail_pour: Your email address, to sign in with a single-use code (the code is kept only as a hash, with the date it was used).
informations_publiques_votre_societe_ann: Your company’s public information (business directory, filed accounts, BODACC), reused for 24 hours. Older copies are no longer used, but are not yet deleted automatically.
reponses_vos_questionnaires_chiffres_que: Your answers to the questionnaires, the figures you enter or upload, and your valuations.
fichiers_que_vous_importez_liasse: The files you upload (tax return, documents, logo, photos) and the generated documents (datapack, teaser, memorandum). For the “Management team” page of the memorandum: the name, role and background of the people you present and, only with their consent as confirmed by you, their photo.
pour_limiter_abus_empreinte_salee: To limit abuse: a salted, non-reversible hash of your IP address (and, for the quotas of automated processing, of your identifier), erased by an automatic clean-up no earlier than two hours (two days for the quotas) after the period concerned. A sign-in code is blocked after 5 wrong attempts.
chat_expert_cession_n_est: The “Sale expert” chat is not available yet: no conversation is recorded.
avec_qui_vos_donnees_sont: Who your data is shared with
vos_donnees_ne_sont_ni: Your data is neither sold nor shared for commercial purposes. It is processed by:
anthropic_modeles_claude_uniquement_pour: Anthropic (Claude models), only for the processing you request: reading your tax return, reading the pages of your website, analyzing the photos you add to the memorandum (a reduced copy of each photo is sent to the Claude API, which describes its content and quality), drafting and reviewing the teaser and the memorandum, market research. Your team's photos and names are never used in the teaser. For market research, Claude searches the web based on your industry, region and business description: do not include your company’s name;
brevo_uniquement_pour_vous_envoyer: Brevo, only to send you the sign-in code and notifications.
si_vous_donnez_adresse_votre: If you provide your website’s address, Passation reads up to eight of its public pages (respecting its robots.txt file).
durees_conservation: Retention periods: a sign-in code is valid for 10 minutes (5 attempts at most); a session lasts 30 days; your company’s public data is reused for 24 hours; your file and its documents are kept until you delete them.
localisation_transferts: Cloudflare and Anthropic are companies based in the United States: your data may be processed there. The safeguards for these transfers outside the European Union are to be reviewed by a lawyer before the public launch.
depuis_votre_espace_bouton_supprimer: From your space, the “Delete my file” button erases in one go the file, its figures, answers, valuations, documents and all associated files, including the management team's photos and backgrounds.
il_ne_supprime_pas_votre: It does not delete your account: your email address, your sign-in sessions and the history of your sign-in codes are kept. Deleting the account is not yet possible from your space: request it through the contact given under “Data controller”.
vous_disposez_droits_acces_rectification: You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability. To exercise them, use the contact given under “Data controller”. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority (cnil.fr).
cookies_techniques: Two technical cookies: one, required for your sign-in session; the other, named “langue”, set only if you choose a language with the EN | FR switcher, so it’s remembered on your next visits (it holds “en” or “fr”, no personal data, and expires after one year). No advertising or audience measurement cookies. Your browser also keeps, in local storage, the date of the last market research run for your file, with no personal data.
meta_description: How Passation handles your data: what we store, who it is shared with, how to delete it and what your rights are.
